title: The Ghost of the DMZ
author: Ines Montrose
blurb: Ansel Iversen, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
